meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Webex 适配器及其注册测试从 channels 分支复制到 src/channels/,追加一行自注册 import,安装固定版本的适配器依赖,再执行构建并跑那条注册测试。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加上 Cisco Webex 频道集成时触发,常见于 /setup 流程中,或之后用 /manage-channels 把它接进 agent group 之前。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 频道集成加到项目里
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册依赖并构建测试

say.text: 跑一下 webex-registration 测试,确认 Webex 已注册
say.note: 测试变红说明 import 或依赖漂移了

say.text: Webex 发消息报 401,帮我排查
say.note: 会先检查 Bot Access Token 是否用错

howto.what_en: Copies the Webex adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends the self-registration import, installs @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Use when adding Cisco Webex channel support to NanoClaw, typically during /setup or before wiring the channel with /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel integration to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers the dep, builds

say_en.text: Run the webex-registration test to confirm Webex is registered
say_en.note: Red means the import or dependency drifted

say_en.text: Webex sends fail with 401, help me debug it
say_en.note: Starts by checking the Bot Access Token
